author: Frank Lockridge
body:
Stu, l mean Steve. Did you actually move on San Francisco? Or is that where SubStack is incorporated or what ever? We really miss you and Glenn chatting back and forth, punching out each other. We know you moved, since we are so old, we can’t remember. We’ll have to look you up to see how the other side of sanity is doing. On the “TOURCH”, we are afraid Glenn has burned things down;) It’s not as interesting when the old gang was together. We’ll adjust as old people do, l guess.

Good luck with your new venture and hope the new features are as interesting as before.

God bless,

Frank and Dianne Lockridge
